name: Banq Pirate
tagline: An Android banking app that changes mode with the environment and supports gesture and voice for low-vision users.

awards: Desjardins - Sponsor Challenge // Desjardins - Défi commandité

problem: The team wanted a banking system that feels alive and helps people with sight difficulties.
solution: Native Android app using camera sensors, on-device hand-gesture recognition and AI voice to switch modes (night, jungle) and assist navigation.
demo_moment: Team-described: move through foliage and the app switches to jungle mode.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Desjardins - Sponsor Challenge // Desjardins - Défi commandité” among 260 submissions.

lessons: Accessibility gives a playful sponsor brief a reason to exist.
